main_body: sci-fi / industrial building with slanted roof, windows and double sliding door
top_band: light blue-grey panelled roof slope from row 1 to row 17 (with roof vents on it)
evidence: Reading the central column from top to bottom: row 0 is dark roof ridge outline, rows 1-16 show the light blue-grey panelled roof surface, row 17 is a bright front-edge highlight line, row 18 is a darker grey eave band above the orange trim (rows 19-20), row 21 is a dark shadow line under the trim, and rows 22-44 form the vertical front wall with an inset doorway (dark top/side inner frame at rows 25-26) and inset windows with bottom sills at row 32.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference buildings (which have dense, individually shaded roof tiles and stone/plaster textures with 5-6 colour ramps), the candidate uses large flat fills on the roof panels (6x3px blocks of a single blue-grey colour), flat vertical wall panels with only sparse single-pixel dots, and heavy near-black outlines around the roof perimeter and window frames, giving it a much simpler, flatter look.
